publisher: City of Los Angeles Office of Finance
ownership: Official public active-business registration records published through the Los Angeles Open Data Portal
source_access: Public anonymous read-only HTTPS Socrata API. The official catalog identifies the dataset as CC0 1.0.
allowed_use: official HTTPS metadata, count, and selected-field API queries
redistribution of aggregate statistics with source attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: representing source inclusion as independent proof that a business is currently operating, open to the public, solvent, licensed for every activity, or present at the address today
representing a reported business location or portal coordinate as independently verified
representing this municipal registration source as every business in Los Angeles, California, or the United States
publishing mailing-address fields, portal-computed region identifiers, or the redundant location-description field
publishing record-level natural-person names or possible residential addresses without an approved privacy review
inferring ownership, parent-company, or cross-source identity relationships without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: City of Los Angeles Office of Finance, Listing of Active Businesses, via data.lacity.org.
retention: Indefinite for immutable selected-field source and governed normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Aggregate counts may be redistributed with City of Los Angeles Office of Finance attribution, source refresh timestamp, source checksum, provenance, and source-specific active-status limitations. Record-level normalized data remains local-review-only pending privacy review even though the source license is CC0.
personal_data_handling: Business names may be natural-person names and business-location addresses may be residences. Mailing fields are excluded at query time; selected source and normalized record-level artifacts remain local, while only aggregate coverage is public by default.
